- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended apps for creating a shared album: Google Photos, Apple Photos, Flickr, Amazon Prime Photos, Cluster, Shutterfly Share.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Apple Photos allows sharing with non-iPhone users via a shared link.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Flickr allows setting permissions for who can add, edit, or view photos.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Amazon Prime Photos allows sharing with non-Prime members.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cluster offers features like commenting, liking, and downloading photos.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shutterfly Share allows ordering prints, albums, and other photo products directly from the app.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested factors to consider when choosing an app: storage limitations, ease of use, permissions, cross-platform compatibility.
